children: New Zealand's top central banker said on Thursday that a gradual removal of monetary stimulus was appropriate to return inflation to within the bank's target range, although core inflation may rise near term due to the indirect effects of higher fuel prices.
"We do expect (core inflation) to continue increasing somewhat over the coming months," Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Anna Breman told a parliamentary committee.
